content: og:image consensus 2026: universal recommendation 1200x630 at 1.91:1 works across Facebook, X, LinkedIn, Discord, Slack, WhatsApp. Facebook min 200x200, rec 1200x630, max 8MB. LinkedIn min 200x200, rec 1200x627, max 5MB. Twitter/X summary_large_image min 300x157, rec 1200x628 (2:1) or 1200x675 (16:9), max 5MB. Practical file-size target under 300KB. Thresholds for a check: critical below 200x200 (unrenderable on FB/LinkedIn), warning below 600x315 or aspect ratio far from 1.91:1, warning above 5MB.
